relations.subject: sdk:view-queries-with-sdk
relations.evidence: Although still maintained and supported for legacy use, Views date from the earliest days of Couchbase Server development, and as such are rarely the best choice over, say, [our Query service](n1ql-query.md) for your application, see [our guide to choosing the right service](querying-your-data.md).

relations.subject: sdk:view-queries-with-sdk
relations.evidence: Views are stored in design documents. The SDK provides convenient methods to create, retrieve, and remove design documents.

notable_absence.finding: The page describes no RBAC role or privilege gate for creating/retrieving/removing design documents, unlike the Search-service and Query-service pages elsewhere in this batch which both name specific roles.

cross_component_finding: This is another instance of the near-verbatim-duplication pattern found elsewhere in this batch (collections.md/working-with-collections.md): this page's deprecation warning and round 3's howtos/view-queries-with-sdk.json extracted quote both make the identical rhetorical move - conceding Views are 'still maintained and supported for legacy use' while steering the reader to the Query service instead - strong grounds for treating sdk:view-queries-with-sdk as one concept across both the concept-docs and howtos layers rather than two.
